quest.title: The Cat's Tail's Bartender
quest.description: They say that there's a popular bartender at The Cat's Tail.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Mmm... drinks at The Cat's Tail. Not bad... not bad at all...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Oh hey, it's you, Traveler. ...Huh? Y—You've never heard of The Cat's Tail?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Judging from your expression, seems like you really don't know the place. Boy, have you been missing out...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: The Cat's Tail is renowned for its incredible specialty drinks. I'm talking drinks you've definitely never tasted before.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: And just as its name suggests, there are loads of cute kitties at The Cat's Tail.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Time simply starts slipping away when you're enjoying a delicious specialty cocktail and surrounded by a bunch of cute kitties...

choices.text: Is The Cat's Tail still open right now?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Uh, but you don't seem of age to drink yet.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Well, that shouldn't be a problem, Diona will be there. She's the best bartender in all of Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: It should be a piece of cake for her to whip you up a drink with no alcohol in it.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Oh, and not to mention, Diona is also pretty cute... just like a little kitty.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: *hic* Oh no... did I say that out loud? Uh, please don't tell her I said that!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Anyway, if you want to check out The Cat's Tail for yourself, the entrance is just around the back.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: I'm gonna... *hic* go over there and sober up a bit, I don't think I can handle a fifth round quite yet... I drank way too much already.

choices.text: I'd like to go check it out...
